name: Mesullemet
title: Queen Mother in Judah
summary: Mesullemet was the daughter of Haruz from Jotbah and the wife of King Manasseh of Judah. She was the mother of King Amon, who reigned in Judah. She is briefly mentioned in 2 Kings as part of the royal lineage of the kingdom of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Manasseh's wife
keyEvents.description: Mesullemet is presented as the daughter of Haruz from Jotbah and the wife of King Manasseh of Judah, who reigned for 55 years in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mother of King Amon
keyEvents.description: Mesullemet was the mother of Amon, who became king after Manasseh and reigned for two years in Jerusalem. She is specifically mentioned as his mother in the royal annals.

keyEvents.title: Amon's short and wicked reign
keyEvents.description: Her son Amon followed in his father Manasseh's sinful footsteps and worshipped idols, but was killed by his own servants after only two years of reign.

keyEvents.title: Manasseh's long and ungodly rule
keyEvents.description: Mesullemet's husband Manasseh led Judah into great sin by reintroducing idolatry, building altars for Baal, and setting up Asherah poles in the Lord's temple.

keyEvents.title: Josiah becomes king after Amon
keyEvents.description: After the murder of Mesullemet's son Amon, her grandson Josiah was installed as king at only eight years old. He would become one of Judah's most godly kings.
